apps.name: Navionics® Boating
apps.description: Get up-to-date, detailed charts you can use offline plus a boatload of features on your mobile device, so they’re on hand wherever you go. The Boating app is a must-have for cruising, fishing, sailing, diving and all your activities on the water. Try it free for a limited time. To continue using charts and advanced features, you can purchase a yearly auto-renewable subscription*. A COMPLETE PACKAGE • INTERNATIONALLY RENOWNED NAVIONICS® CHARTS: Use them offline along with multiple overlays, so you can be more aware of what’s above and below the water. - NAUTICAL CHART: Use this premier marine reference to study port plans, anchorages and safety depth contours, locate navaids, marine services and more. - SONARCHART™ HD BATHYMETRY MAPS: Extraordinary 1’ (0.5 meter) HD bottom contour detail is the ideal tool for locating new fishing areas. - U.S. GOVERNMENT CHARTS (NOAA): These are available within the following coverages: U.S. and Canada, Mexico, Caribbean to Brazil. - OVERLAYS: The relief shading overlay allows you to have a better understanding of bottom topography for improved fishing and diving. Sonar imagery reveals bottom hardness clearly and in vivid color on select lakes. Want more? Display satellite imagery on land and water. - MAP OPTIONS: Change chart-overlay combinations to customize chart views, activate night mode, highlight shallow areas, target multiple fishing ranges and more. - DAILY UPDATES: Benefit of thousands of daily updates worldwide. • TOOLS FOR PLANNING AND ENJOYING YOUR DAY - AUTO GUIDANCE+TM TECHNOLOGY**: Easily plan your trip with a suggested dock-to-dock path based on chart data and navigation aids. Get ETA, distance to arrival, heading to waypoint, fuel consumption and more. - WEATHER AND TIDES: Knowing conditions before heading out is crucial. Access real-time weather data, daily and hourly forecasts as well as wind, weather buoys, tides and currents. - MARKERS, TRACKS, DISTANCE: Place a marker on a good anchorage spot or where you reeled in a big fish. Record your track, take photos and videos within the app, and look back at your day anytime. Easily check distance among two points. • AN ACTIVE AND HELPFUL COMMUNITY - COMMUNITY EDITS and the ACTIVECAPTAIN® COMMUNITY: Obtain and contribute useful local knowledge along with thousands of fellow boaters, such as points of interest, navigation aids and valuable recommendations from people with firsthand experience of the local environment. - CONNECTIONS: Stay in touch with your friends and fellow boaters by sharing your live location, tracks, routes and markers to easily meet on the water or let them check out your adventures. - GPX IMPORT/EXPORT: Share your saved data outside the app or transfer it to your chartplotter. - SHARE MAP OBJECTS: Share a marina, repair shop or any other location outside the app. • EXTERNAL DEVICE-FRIENDLY FOR MORE FEATURES - PLOTTER SYNC: If you own a compatible chartplotter, sync it with the app to transfer routes and markers, activate, update or renew your Navionics chartplotter card subscription. - SONARCHART LIVE MAPPING FEATURE***: Connect with a compatible sonar/plotter, and create your own maps in real time while navigating. - AIS: Connect to a compatible AIS receiver with Wi-Fi® connectivity to see nearby marine traffic. Set a safe range, and receive visual and aural alerts to signal potential collisions. NOTES: *You can manage your subscription anytime, and you can turn auto-renewal off. **Auto Guidance+ is for planning purposes only and does not replace safe navigation operations ***Free features A tablet device with Wi-Fi connectivity locates your approximate position if it is connected to Wi-Fi. A tablet Wi-Fi + 3G model operates similarly to a phone device with GPS. Wi-Fi is a registered trademark of the Wi-Fi Alliance. iOS is a trademark licensed to Apple, Inc.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe. SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again. UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs. SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it. PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. apps.name: TalkingParents: Co-Parent App
apps.description: Parents who are divorced, separated, or were never legally married use TalkingParents to manage all communication regarding their children. Whether your co-parenting situation is amicable or high conflict, our cutting-edge tools make joint custody easier to navigate, while keeping interactions saved to a court-admissible Record. TalkingParents is here to help you coordinate more seamlessly, set boundaries, and focus on what matters most: your children. Secure Messaging: Send messages that can’t be edited or deleted and easily organize them by topic. All messages and read receipts are timestamped, allowing you to see when your co-parent sent or viewed a message. Sentiment Scanner + Writing Assist: Scan messages for sentiment before you send them to understand how your words may come across. Rewrite messages using professionally developed communication methods designed to reduce tension and minimize conflict. Accountable Calling: Make phone and video calls, complete with recordings and transcripts, without ever having to share your phone number. Shared Calendar: Manage custody schedules and your child’s appointments and activities all on a Shared Calendar that both parents can access. Create single events for things like doctor’s appointments and repeating events for your child’s extracurriculars and custody transition days. Accountable Payments: Make payment requests and securely send or receive money, allowing you to keep track of all shared parenting expenses. Requests and payments are timestamped, and you can also schedule monthly recurring payments. Info Library: Share important details about the kids with customizable cards that both parents can access without having to contact each other. This feature is a great place to store frequently used information like clothing sizes, medical information, and more. Personal Journal: Keep private notes about thoughts and interactions you want recorded for later. Whether it’s in-person discussions with your co-parent or child behavior observances, journal entries are just for you and can include up to five attachments. Vault File Storage: Store photos, videos, and important documents. Your Vault cannot be accessed by your co-parent, but you may choose to share files with any third party by copying or emailing a link, which can be set to expire. You can also download files to your device. Unalterable Records: All interactions within TalkingParents are stored to Unalterable Records that are trusted by legal professionals and accepted in courtrooms nationwide. Each Record includes a Digital Signature and unique 16-digit Authentication Code that verifies the Record is genuine and has not been modified in any way. PDF and Printed Records are available for Secure Messaging, Accountable Calling, Shared Calendar, Accountable Payments, Info Library, and Personal Journal. FAQs: Do I have to be on the same plan as my co-parent? No, you can communicate through TalkingParents no matter what plan your co-parent is on. We offer three different plans—Essentials, Enhanced, or Ultimate. Is TalkingParents court-monitored? No, though Unalterable Records are court-admissible and can be used as evidence in family law cases, no one monitors interactions between you and your co-parent. This is for the privacy of our users. Can I change plans? Yes, TalkingParents offers monthly subscriptions that make it easy to modify your plan at any time. If you don’t think your needs will change throughout the year, we also offer annual plans that include an 8% discount. Can my account be deleted? No, TalkingParents does not allow the deletion of accounts once created and matched. This ensures that neither co-parent can remove an account and clear messages, call records, or other details within the service. To review our terms and privacy practices, please visit our Terms of Service at https://talkingparents.com/terms-of-service and our Privacy Policy at https://talkingparents.com/privacy-policy.

apps.description: Shoom is an AI music and video generator that turns your ideas into songs and music videos. Create original songs with your own style, sound, and lyrics, then add your photo to generate personalized AI music videos. An easier alternative to complex production tools, this AI music maker works for everyone, whether you're a complete beginner or a musician pushing past a creative block. From quick song demos and background tracks to pure creative exploration, Shoom puts music creation right into your hands. With Shoom, you can: — Turn a text prompt into a complete vocal or instrumental AI song in minutes. — Write lyrics or use the built-in lyric generator to craft words to fit your track. — Record or upload your voice and transform it into unique AI music. — Reimagine songs with an AI Cover and hear them with fresh new voices. — Create personalized AI music videos using your photos and favorite Shoom songs. KEY FEATURES ● DESCRIBE IT, HEAR IT Type a title, choose a genre, set the mood, and let Shoom handle the rest. From rap and classical to K-pop and rock—this AI music maker supports a wide range of genres, vibes, and atmospheres. ● BRING YOUR LYRICS TO LIFE Got lyrics but no melody? Paste your words into the AI song writer and hear them come alive with vocals, instruments, and full production—or generate lyrics instantly and edit them to fit your vision. ● MAKE MUSIC WITH YOUR VOICE Speak, sing, or hum—Voice Mode turns recordings into AI-generated songs with their own unique sound. Record live or upload audio, and Shoom will build the music around your voice. ● TURN PHOTOS INTO AI MUSIC VIDEOS Upload your photo, choose a background and a song, and watch them come together as a custom AI music video. Create unique music videos inspired by any genre, mood, or style you love. ● COVER IT YOUR WAY Reimagine your favorite tracks on the fly. Create an AI cover with a fresh vocal style and discover a whole new energy in a song you already love. ● SAVE IT, KEEP IT, GET IT All your AI songs, all in one place—everything stays saved and ready to go. Play tracks anytime and download them to share your AI music with friends and family. HOW DOES SHOOM WORK? 1. Pick a genre and describe the sound you want. 2. Add your own lyrics or let the AI song maker create them from scratch. 3. Enter a title for your track. 4. Tap generate, and your track will be ready in minutes. 5. Listen, download, and share with anyone. Start making AI music that sounds like you. Download Shoom and turn your next idea into a song. FAQ Q: Is Shoom beginner-friendly? A: Yes. This AI music maker is built so anyone can create a song on their first try—the whole process takes a couple of minutes and requires zero musical background. Q: What genres are supported? A: Pop, rock, rap, R&B, classical, indie, jazz, EDM, country, reggae, and more. Every AI song you make can be shaped to match the genre and mood you have in mind. Q: What makes Shoom different? A: Shoom is an AI music generator built around simplicity—just describe what you want to hear, and the app will handle the production, arrangement, and mixing for you. Q: Can I make a music video starring myself? A: Sure! Upload a photo, choose a background, and pair it with your favorite AI-generated song. Shoom will turn it into a personalized AI music video you can watch, download, and share. SHOOM PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION Subscribe to Shoom Premium to generate more AI music and songs. apps.name: Evernote: AI Notes & Notebook
apps.description: Evernote is your second brain — the place to keep everything that matters and find it again the moment you need it. "…an invaluable tool for organizing a messy digital life." — The New York Times Capture a thought, a to-do, a photo, or a whole project, then let Evernote help you organize it, make sense of it, transcribe a meeting or tidy up a rough draft, and bring it back exactly when it counts. From the first spark of an idea to the finished plan, it all lives in one calm, searchable place — at work, at home, and everywhere in between. CAPTURE ANYTHING Jot a quick note, build a checklist, save a photo, an email or a PDF, or clip an article from the web before it disappears. Type it out, write by hand, snap a picture, or record a voice memo — whatever's fastest in the moment. Your ideas land in one place, ready when you are, so nothing gets lost on a sticky note or buried in your inbox. STAY ORGANIZED, EFFORTLESSLY Sort notes into notebooks and add tags, or just start writing and let structure follow. Group related notes together, pin the ones you reach for most, and keep work, school, and life neatly apart — without spending your day tidying up. Evernote keeps things in order so you can stay focused on the thinking. FIND WHAT YOU NEED, FAST Search across everything you've saved — including the text inside your images and PDFs. Ask in plain language and Semantic Search surfaces the right note, even when you can't remember the exact words or where you put it. The more you save, the more useful it becomes. MEET YOUR AI ASSISTANT Your AI Assistant clears away the busywork so you can stay in the thinking, working quietly alongside you. Record a conversation and Evernote AI transcribes and summarizes it for you; AI Transcription turns audio, images, and video into text; and AI Edit cleans up a rough draft, shortens it, or changes the tone while keeping it in your own voice. PLAN YOUR DAY Add due dates, reminders, and to-dos right inside your notes, so the next step is always clear and nothing slips through the cracks. Check things off as you go and keep momentum without switching apps. WORK EVERYWHERE Your notes sync automatically across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, and the web — start on one device and pick up right where you left off on another. Evernote works offline too, so you're never locked out of your own ideas, even when you're far from a signal. FOR WORK, SCHOOL, AND LIFE - Plan projects, prep meetings, and keep every detail in one place. - Take lecture notes, organize research, and study smarter for exams. - Save recipes, plan trips, track goals, and remember the little things that matter. - Keep a journal, draft your next big idea, and capture inspiration whenever it strikes. "Its magic lies in its flexibility." — PCMag However you think, and whatever you're working on, Evernote helps you remember everything and get it done. Capture today's idea — and find it the moment you need it.

apps.name: Surge 5
apps.description: Surge is an advanced network toolbox and proxy utility. It is designed for developers and therefore requires professional knowledge to use. These four capabilities form the core workflow of Surge: · Takeover: Take over the network connections sent by the device. Surge supports both proxy service and virtual NIC takeover, capturing HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and UDP traffic from any app — even those ignoring proxy settings. As the first mapping tool to offer interactive GPS fishing maps for every trout stream in the continental United States, TroutRoutes provides comprehensive information for each stream and river. Find local fishing spots, explore new waters, and navigate public access like a pro. View maps of over 50,000 trout streams across 48 states, access 280,000+ hand-curated access points, and view 360 million acres of public land. Forecast with real-time stream conditions, view local regulations, and save detailed maps with your own markups for offline use. Plan your fly fishing trip with advanced filters and decide what you want to see on the map. View trail access, public or private bridges, parking spots, camping opportunities, boat ramps, and more. Filter rivers by fish species, now available in nine western states. TroutRoutes is the only App that combines classified trout streams, hand-curated access points, and live USGS stream gauge data in one place. Endorsed by fly fishing professionals and industry partners, find more information in local fly shops such as Orvis. Access a complete trout fishing tool and start exploring new streams with TroutRoutes. TroutRoutes by onX Features: ▶ How can I use TroutRoutes to find new streams? Navigate the map or search bar to find color-coded streams, organized by stream class. With over 50,000 trout streams mapped out across 48 states, TroutRoutes delivers an industry-first national trout quality classification system. Plan your trip based on habitat quality, public access opportunities, and more. ▶ How can I navigate public land and water access? View information on public and private land and download detailed offline maps. Fish confidently with land boundary data that lets you see exactly where you are as you move upstream, even without cell service. Download maps by river or region, and navigate through fishing easements, national forests, or local parks with GPS mapping. ▶ How can TroutRoutes help me plan my next fly fishing trip? Set custom markups, filter rivers by species, and navigate new waters with 280,000+ unique and hand-curated public access points. Create personalized maps by adding your points of interest. Filter your map by fish species in CA, WA, OR, MT, WY, CO, UT, ID, and NV. ▶ How can I find the right time and stream to fish? Access real-time stream conditions and compare historical data to forecast the best times to fish. Get live river flow and chart readings with our USGS gauge layer. See slope and contour details for every stream with interactive elevation charts. Identify tailwater, reservoirs, headwaters, and meadows. ▶ Does TroutRoutes give me access to local regulations and fly fishing shops? View fly fishing regulations and information on fly shops directly in the App. See color-coded fishing regulations and local stream classes. Locate nearby fly shops and view their website and contact info. Plan ahead with parking locations, bridge access, trailheads, put-ins, and more. Easy to use for beginners and seasoned pros alike, TroutRoutes takes the guesswork out of fly fishing. Plan your next trout fishing adventure today. ▶ Free Trial: Start a 7-day PRO trial for free when you install the App. ▶ Basic Plan (Free): Multi-platform access across desktop and mobile, a basic view of trout streams, and other limited features. ▶ Single-State ($19.99/year): Full PRO features for one state: classified streams, access points, custom markups, offline maps, and more. ▶ PRO ($39.99/year or $9.99/month): Complete access across 48 states, including: • 50,000+ classified trout streams • 280,000+ custom access points • 360 million acres of public land • Real-time data, offline maps, fishing regulations ▶ Terms of Use: https://www.onxmaps.com/tou ▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy

apps.name: Screen Mirroring App: Smart TV
apps.description: Ideal for iPhone owners who want to mirror their screen, cast web videos, and share photos or videos on a compatible Smart TV. Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV delivers fast, ad-free, low-latency casting without Apple TV, HDMI cables, extra hardware, or signing in to TV apps. Join more than 12.5 million users who bring their favorite iPhone content to the big screen. BEST FOR • Watching anime, web videos, and streams not available in native TV apps • Mirroring presentations, documents, apps, and websites • Sharing family photos and home videos on a larger display • Casting to hotel TVs while traveling without signing in on the TV KEY FEATURES ◆ SCREEN MIRRORING Mirror your entire iPhone display to your TV in real time — run presentations without a projector, show games on a larger screen, or browse the web on your TV from the comfort of your couch. ◆ WEB VIDEO CAST Use the built-in browser to find and cast online videos directly to your TV. Watch YouTube, anime, web series, news, live streams, and other supported content — all controlled from your iPhone. ◆ PHOTO & VIDEO CASTING Cast photos and videos from your iPhone gallery to your Smart TV. Share vacation memories, family milestones, and home videos together on the big screen. ◆ AD-FREE, SMOOTH STREAMING The app is ad-free and optimized for fast connection and minimal delay, helping you stay focused on your content without interruptions. HOW TO CONNECT IPHONE TO TV • Connect your iPhone and Smart TV to the same Wi-Fi network • Open the app and tap “Connect TV” • Select your TV from the available devices • Choose Screen Mirroring, Web Video, Photos, Videos, or Live Camera COMPATIBLE TVS & DEVICES • Samsung Smart TVs • LG Smart TVs • Roku players and Roku TVs • Amazon Fire TV and Fire TV Stick • Google Chromecast • Vizio Smart TVs • Other compatible Smart TVs with Wi-Fi casting support Compatibility may vary by TV model and supported casting technology. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Can I mirror my iPhone to a Samsung TV? Yes. Connect to a compatible Samsung Smart TV over Wi-Fi to mirror your iPhone screen or cast content. apps.description: Translate text, speech, pictures, documents, and subtitles anytime, anywhere. InstantTranslator is an AI-powered translation app for travel, study, work, and multilingual communication. Cloud translation supports more than 100 languages. Offline language availability may vary. [Key Features] • Text Translator Translate messages, emails, documents, chats, and webpages. • Voice & Speech Translator Recognize and translate spoken words for conversations, meetings, travel, and language learning. • Camera & Photo Translator Capture text from signs, menus, documents, or photos and translate it instantly. • Picture-in-Picture Subtitles Watch foreign-language videos with real-time translated subtitles in a floating window. • Live Conversation Translate both sides of a bilingual conversation in real time. • Document & PDF Translator Translate PDFs, papers, and other supported documents. • Offline Translation Translate without an internet connection using downloaded on-device language models. Offline translation is powered by Google Translate (https://translate.google.com) using on-device ML Kit models, including the text translation step used in text, voice, camera, photo, and screen translation modes. Speech recognition, text recognition, and text-to-speech may use separate technologies. Offline language availability differs from cloud translation. • 100+ Languages Cloud translation supports more than 100 languages, including Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Arabic, French, Russian, Portuguese, German, Italian, Polish, Thai, and more. apps.name: Bark - Parental Controls
apps.description: Bark provides families with all the tools they need to raise kids in the digital age. Our comprehensive service lets you monitor content, manage screen time, and filter websites so you can get peace of mind while your child is online. CONTENT MONITORING Bark monitors your child’s texts, email, YouTube, and 30+ apps and social media platforms for issues like cyberbullying, adult content, sexual predators, profanity, suicidal ideation, threats of violence, and more. Parents receive alerts only when something potentially problematic occurs online. You won’t have full access to everything on your child’s phone — just the things you might need to know about. SCREEN TIME MANAGEMENT Families can set healthy time limits and create schedules for when their children’s devices can connect to the internet (through both cell service and Wi-Fi). WEB FILTERING Our web filter lets you select which websites your child can access on their devices. You can allow or block specific sites — or even whole categories like streaming services, online gaming, sexual content, and more. BARK TESTIMONIALS • "My wife and I LOVE Bark. We've had some tough but productive conversations with our 13-year-old son. It's proving to be extremely valuable." — Josh L. • “It’s just another set of protections we as parents give our kids for the digital environment (or as my 10-year-old calls it, a “cell phone seat belt”). My oldest is a 9th grader, and while I trust her, I’ve come to realize through the alerts that some of her friends aren’t truly her friends. It’s led to some amazing conversations about choosing friends wisely and recognizing toxic people. While she wasn’t for Bark at first, she’s since said she’s grateful that I saw those messages because it reaffirmed what she was feeling but didn’t know how to verbalize without sounding sensitive.” — Bark Parent • "Bark notified me that my young daughter had unknowingly revealed her phone number to strangers on Twitter. The fact that Bark notified me was impressive and led to an informative discussion with her the same day." — Jon B. • “Since Bark alerted us to the suicidal language used in the Google doc that was being used in a chat document with a friend, we have seen both a pediatrician and a licensed counselor. We are hopeful for a positive outcome. Thanks to Bark for letting us peek into our child’s mind!” — Bark Parent • “This app is a lifesaver! It has allowed us to catch so many “red flags” in the content my kids have accessed on their devices and in their interactions with friends and other people online that I wouldn’t have ever known about otherwise. The big difference between Bark and other “Parental Control” software is that Bark allows your kids to have so much more privacy. It doesn’t show you everything they do, but sends an instant alert regarding any activity that might be concerning. Highly recommended!” — Bark Parent With Bark, you can help keep your kids safe both online and in real life. Try it out for seven days absolutely free! Our Family Online Safety Specialists are standing by to help answer any questions you may have. Email help@bark.us or visit help.bark.us to get answers and advice from the Bark Team. PRIMARY FEATURES • Remote Sensor Monitoring • Custom Push Notification Alerts • Data Graphs for Daily Trends • Data Exports for Historical Tracking • Personalized App Experience [Custom Images, Naming, Device Order] • Ability to Share Devices • Manage Numerous Locations/Devices with One Account • Connects Weather Stations/Gateways to Wi-Fi • Controls Forecast Settings Unique to Wi-Fi Weather Stations WI-FI WEATHER STATIONS La Crosse View allows you to remotely track weather conditions such as temperature, humidity, wind, rain, and more, giving you access to hyperlocal data from sensors right in your backyard. The app is required to connect weather station displays to Wi-Fi, program location settings to receive local Internet weather forecasts on the stations, and set up Data Streams for custom messaging and weather updates. ALERT & MONITORING SYSTEMS Monitor water detection for basements, sinks, and appliances, temperature throughout your home (or in the freezer), humidity in various spaces, open/closed status of doors and gates, pool conditions, food temps, and more. La Crosse View is required to connect Bridge Gateways (sensor relays) to Wi-Fi, set and receive custom app alerts, and view data remotely, anytime, anywhere. EASY SETUP & MANAGEMENT La Crosse View features a guided walkthrough that ensures Weather Stations and Bridge Gateways sync with your Wi-Fi network, and wireless sensors are easily paired with your app. From there, customize sensor locations with personal images for easy reference, view detailed graphs to study trends over time, manage multiple locations and devices from one application, and share access with family members as needed. Whether you're setting up your first sensor or expanding a system as your needs grow, La Crosse View supports your journey—from first home to dream home. POPULAR USE CASES Indoor Monitoring • Basement temp & humidity • Freezer or refrigerator temperature alerts • Nursery or bedroom comfort monitoring • Wine cellar or storage room conditions Outdoor Monitoring • Backyard weather conditions • Pool and hot tub temperature • Garden and greenhouse environments Appliance & Utility Areas • Water heater monitoring • Washing machine area leak detection • Sump pump area conditions • Garage and basement freeze warnings Outbuildings & Unconditioned Spaces • Barns and sheds • Detached garages • Pavilions and event spaces • Ice shanties and seasonal shelters Hobby & Specialty Uses • BBQ and smoker temperature tracking • Musical instrument protection • Home brewing climate • Pet habitat monitoring • Humidor conditions • Vehicle storage temperature Entry Points & Security-Adjacent • Door and window contact status • Cabinets or mailbox open/closed status • Gate position monitoring • Workshop or storage access HARDWARE REQUIREMENTS To receive data, the La Crosse View app requires a La Crosse Technology Wi-Fi Weather Station or Bridge Gateway with at least one compatible sensor. Visit www.lacrossetechnology.com/pages/la-crosse-view for more details and to explore available systems and sensors. ABOUT LA CROSSE TECHNOLOGY Family-owned and operated out of La Crosse, WI, since 1983, we strive to create innovative products that inform, inspire, and enhance everyday life. Harnessing the power of monitoring, time, and weather, with a deep focus on reliability, we assure accurate information and lasting value.

apps.name: TextPort: Text Message Export
apps.description: TextPort turns any text conversation on your iPhone into a print-ready, timestamped PDF, a searchable CSV spreadsheet, or a plain text transcript. Pick a conversation and TextPort pulls it straight out of iMessage, right on your iPhone. It works with iMessage, SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram DMs, Telegram, Signal, Viber, Snapchat, WeChat, LINE, and more. No cable, no Mac, and no Apple backup needed. When you want your complete iMessage history, the companion TextPort desktop app for Mac and Windows exports full conversations from your computer. HOW IT WORKS 1. Open TextPort and tap Import 2. Choose the Messages conversation you want to export 3. Pick the date range you need, from a few days to the whole history 4. TextPort imports every message with its sender, wording, date, and time, in order. Export to PDF, CSV, or text, then print, save, or share FOR COURT AND LEGAL EVIDENCE TextPort produces clean, paginated PDFs with per-message timestamps and sender names. This is the format people file in family law, housing court, and civil disputes. People use it to prepare text messages for court, custody cases, divorce, small claims, HR complaints, and protective orders. No app makes a court-certified export; courts authenticate text messages through testimony that the export came from your own device and was not altered. The original conversation stays on your phone as a verifiable record that the export was not manipulated. TextPort leaves it untouched, so both the source and the export live on the same device, ready for lawyers, mediators, or insurance claims. THE STATE OF TEXTING AS EVIDENCE 2026 TextPort surveyed 1,081 U.S. adults about how people save, lose, and use text messages in disputes. 81% have screenshotted a text because they might need it as proof. 38% have had texts or DMs used in a legal, workplace, or other formal proceeding they were part of. 78% have deleted or lost messages they later wished they had kept. 32% of those who tried to save a full conversation found it hard or could not do it at all. The full report is free to read and cite on the TextPort website. WORKS WITH YOUR MESSAGING APPS TextPort works with messaging apps across your iPhone or iPad, including iMessage, SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, Telegram, Signal, Viber, Snapchat, WeChat, and LINE. WhatsApp chats export to PDF with sender names, dates, and times. You never touch WhatsApp's chat-export file, dig through a backup, or email a chat to yourself. EXPORT FORMATS • PDF: save an entire text thread as a multi-page, timestamped, print-ready document • CSV: searchable spreadsheets for Excel, Numbers, or Sheets • Plain text: transcripts you can paste anywhere MORE WAYS PEOPLE USE TEXTPORT • Save text messages on iPhone permanently and archive years of conversations • Download text messages from iPhone before switching phones or a factory reset • Save a loved one's messages as a keepsake • Print WhatsApp chats as relationship evidence for USCIS applications • Document harassment for HR or the police • Keep business conversations for compliance and record-keeping WHY TEXTPORT • Works directly on your iPhone: most exporters are desktop software, but with TextPort you import, convert, and print text messages from iPhone, no computer needed • One app to export text messages from iPhone: an iMessage exporter that also handles the other chat apps on your phone • Desktop app included: extract text messages from iPhone backups and export your full iMessage and SMS history as a text message backup on Mac and Windows • A person answers your support questions, not a bot SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS TextPort is free to download; a subscription is required to export. A subscription unlocks unlimited message exporting, all file formats including PDF export, and premium customer support.
